mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer and business demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase month-over-month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), rising inflation erodes real corporate profits and prompts aggressive monetary tightening by the Fed, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing and services activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where INDPRO increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and stable or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates that the Fed is not adequately responding to inflation, which erodes real returns and triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS monthly change <= 0.0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS monthly change <= 0.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (characterized by GDP growth above 2.5% annualized), strong GDP growth (GDPC1) signals sustained economic momentum that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is above 2.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
